review_candidates.title: Program Manager – Infrastructure Automation
review_candidates.description: Iron Bow Technologies is for people who believe trust is paramount , transformation is embraced , and the future is here , because "What we do matters !" We are a next generation solutions provider, delivering mission success across government, healthcare, and commercial industries. Iron Bow relies on our passionate people , long standing partnerships , and strategic thinking to solve your most critical challenges. Whether we team with clients, colleagues, or partners, we put each other first. It’s The Iron Bow Way. THE OPPORTUNITY Iron Bow is seeking an experienced Program Manager In this role, you will serve as the senior contractor leader and primary point of accountability for the successful delivery of a complex, enterprise-wide infrastructure automation and modernization program supporting VA OIT. You will lead a multidisciplinary technical team responsible for advancing VA’s centralized infrastructure automation capabilities across hybrid environments, including on-premises data centers, private infrastructure, and VA Enterprise Cloud environments. This role requires strong Federal program leadership, technical program management, and the ability to bring multiple technical workstreams together to reduce technical debt, configuration drift, security exposure, manual processes, and infrastructure delivery timelines. This position is primarily remote/Contractor facility-based, with travel and onsite support at VA locations as required. HOW YOU'LL MAKE AN IMPACT Serve as the primary contractor management interface with VA program leadership, contracting officials, technical teams, security organizations, and other key stakeholders. Lead overall program execution across platform engineering, automation architecture, infrastructure-as-code (IaC), enterprise integration, governance, security/RMF, training, adoption, knowledge transfer, and transition. Develop and maintain the Contractor Project Management Plan (CPMP) and integrated program schedule, including milestones, resources, dependencies, risks, deliverables, and reporting requirements. Coordinate multidisciplinary technical teams, subcontractors, and technology partners to ensure workstreams remain aligned with approved architecture, security requirements, contractual commitments, and VA priorities. Manage program risks, issues, dependencies, and corrective actions, proactively identifying potential impacts to cost, schedule, technical performance, security, and mission outcomes. Monitor program performance against contractual requirements, QASP metrics, KPIs, deliverables, staffing requirements, automation adoption, and knowledge-transfer objectives. Lead monthly program reporting, program reviews, and Quarterly Governance Reviews, providing VA leadership with clear visibility into program health, performance, risks, decisions, and corrective actions. Maintain appropriate staffing and oversee personnel assignments, onboarding, required certifications, background investigations, vacancies, and continuity of program operations. Coordinate activities required to achieve and maintain the VA Authority to Operate (ATO), including RMF documentation, security assessments, POA&M management, and continuous monitoring. Oversee the phased onboarding and adoption of VA infrastructure teams onto the standardized automation platform, driving measurable movement from manual processes toward standardized automation. Lead knowledge transfer, training, operational documentation, and transition-readiness activities to build VA’s ability to independently operate and evolve the automation environment. Manage program performance within the Firm-Fixed-Price contract structure, including labor, travel, subcontractors, software/OEM coordination, deliverables, and resource allocation. SKILLS THAT DRIVE SUCCESS 10+ years of IT program/project management experience, including at least 5 years leading large, complex Federal technology programs. Experience managing Federal infrastructure modernization, enterprise automation, or similarly complex IT programs . Proven experience leading large, multidisciplinary technical teams supporting enterprise IT environments. Experience managing programs involving infrastructure, cloud/hybrid environments, automation, DevSecOps/IaC, cybersecurity, and IT service management. Experience managing integrated schedules, risks, dependencies, deliverables, staffing, performance metrics, and executive-level reporting. Demonstrated ability to coordinate across engineering teams, technology partners, subcontractors, Government organizations, and executive stakeholders. Experience managing programs that combine commercial software licensing and professional services . Strong understanding of Federal contracting environments and managing delivery against contractual scope, performance requirements, schedules, and commitments. Strong leadership, communication, problem-solving, organizational, and executive stakeholder-management skills. Project Management Professional (PMP) certification required. ITIL v4 Foundation certification required. Must be able to successfully complete and maintain a Tier 4 / High Risk Background Investigation . WHAT SETS YOU APART Experience supporting the Department of Veterans Affairs OIT or another large, complex Federal IT organization. Experience with infrastructure-as-code, configuration management, enterprise automation/orchestration, DevSecOps, and Git-based delivery models. Familiarity with Terraform/HashiCorp, Ansible, Red Hat/OpenShift, VMware, ServiceNow, GitHub Enterprise, CyberArk, Splunk, and Dynatrace . Working knowledge of Federal RMF/ATO, NIST 800-37/800-53, FISMA, Zero Trust, FICAM/PIV, and Section 508 requirements. Experience establishing enterprise governance models, KPIs, executive dashboards, risk registers, and continuous-improvement programs. Experience leading organizational change and technology adoption across enterprise infrastructure teams. WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT! Make an enterprise-wide impact: Lead a high-visibility modernization initiative transforming how infrastructure is automated and delivered across a complex Federal environment. Shape the future of automation: Help establish scalable, standardized automation capabilities designed to reduce technical debt, improve security, and accelerate infrastructure delivery. Lead across the enterprise: Work alongside VA leadership, engineering, security, architecture, and technology partners to drive meaningful change across teams and environments. Own the outcome: Take a highly visible leadership role with the opportunity to influence program strategy, execution, adoption, and long-term success. COMPENSATION AND BENEFIT INFORMATION The salary range for this position is $160,000-190,000/yr . This range reflects the anticipated base pay for the position and is not a guarantee of final compensation. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, skills, education, location, contract requirements, and business needs. Iron Bow Technologies reserves the right to fill this role at a different level, depending on qualifications and organizational priorities. This range represents only one component of Iron Bow’s total compensation package. An overview of our benefits is available on our careers page. OUR EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER COMMITMENT Iron Bow Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions at Iron Bow are based on relevant business considerations, such as operational needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or gender expression, pregnancy, national origin, age, disability, status as a protected veteran or any other characteristic prohibited by law. Iron Bow will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics.
